statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 11 is low and well below the block threshold.
recommendation: Range conditions are absorbing flow: both session boundaries have been tested and rejected and a genuine retracement has delivered, with volatility decaying through the move. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. The single mapped danger window is 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 around the Jackson Hole keynote cluster.
headline: Third rejection at 29,660 delivers a real 130-point retracement while VIX prints a new session low at 14.44; Tail eases to 11
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade at 29,533.00, up 243.50 points or 0.83% from the 29,289.50 prior settlement, roughly three hours into the U.S. cash session. The session range is 29,401.75-29,661.50 against an opening print of 29,499.50. The decisive observation since the prior assessment is that the market produced a marginal new high, rejected it, and then handed back roughly 130 points. That is the third rejection of the 29,660 area and, more importantly, the first clean retracement of size in the move: mean reversion is delivering rather than failing, which is the exact behaviour Tail measures the absence of. Cash agrees. The Nasdaq-100 index reads 29,518.27, up 1.01%, inside an unchanged 29,366.42-29,568.10 range, so the past hour set no new cash extreme at either end. QQQ trades at 718.36, up 0.98%, having printed a marginal new high at 719.58 before easing back inside its 714.53 low. Both boundaries have now been traded and both have been rejected, and the range is narrowing rather than expanding. Volatility continues to decay through all of it. VIX trades at 14.49, down 4.74%, and set a fresh session low at 14.44 against a 15.21 prior close. An index up 1% whose volatility index makes new lows during the pullback is orderly price discovery, not repricing. Cross-asset confirmation remains absent, which keeps the dominant mode assessed as mixed rather than trend-up. The 10-year constant maturity stands at 4.64% and the 2-year at 4.17% on the most recent H.15 publication, with Treasury futures across the 2Y-30Y curve effectively unchanged on the session; there is no rates amplifier. WTI trades near $82.70, up 0.57%, on the familiar combination of Russian export disruption against improving Strait of Hormuz shipping prospects, which remains a managed-disruption regime rather than a new geopolitical discontinuity. Leadership is broad but internally split, and that split is the structural reason directional efficiency has not formed. The Nasdaq Composite is up 1.32% against the S&P 500 up 0.62% and the Dow up 0.29%, so the tape is tech-led rather than uniform. Nvidia trades up around 6.5-8.8% after fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.22 billion and third-quarter guidance near $108 billion, while Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta all trade lower; only three of the eight largest weights are positive. Software supplies a second leg of leadership, with Salesforce up about 20.7%, Okta about 27.5% and CrowdStrike about 17.2%. The semiconductor complex is uniformly higher, but the largest index weights pulling against each other is precisely what prevents that strength from becoming index-level one-way flow. Macro is settled for the day. Initial jobless claims for the week to Aug 22 printed 203,000 against a 208,000 consensus, continuing claims 1,778,000, and the advance goods trade deficit widened to $118.8 billion; none of it moved rates or volatility. Mapped policy state remains EA_ON, with Tail well below the block threshold. The forward risk sits entirely at the far edge of the horizon: Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, at the same instant as the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, with Chicago PMI fifteen minutes earlier. Both the keynote hour and the delayed-second-leg hour that follows now fall inside this forecast horizon, and they are the only two hours mapped outside the low band.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours cover the Nvidia release and its complete digestion. From 16:00 UTC on Aug 26 the regime was mixed and calm, with Tail decaying from 12 to 10 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 57 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour was the only non-green hour in the window, moving to WATCH at Tail 21 and Stress 66. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised outlook, and the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. Through the Asian and European hours the regime returned to mixed at Tail 10-11 with Stress easing to 45-47, the calmest stretch of the window. The 13:00 UTC hour lifted to Tail 14 and Stress 54 into the cash open, then eased to 12 at 14:00 and 15:00 UTC as the opening auction faded and the range began absorbing flow rather than extending. Three hours are unavailable because no assessment was published for them: 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 during the futures maintenance break, and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27. Every available hour except the release hour mapped to EA_ON.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one quiet U.S. afternoon and one genuine catalyst cluster at the far edge. With both range boundaries tested and rejected and a real retracement now delivered, conditional Tail sits at 11 through the rest of today's cash session, lifting to 14 across the 19:00-20:00 UTC closing window for month-end rebalancing and closing imbalances. After the cash close the estimate steps down, with the 21:00 UTC maintenance break the structural low at 9, and holds a 10-11 overnight floor through the Asian hours in normal mode. From the 07:00 UTC European open the path drifts up through 12-13 as the keynote countdown compresses positioning, reaching 14 in the U.S. pre-market and 16 in the 13:00 UTC hour that carries the Friday cash open alongside Chicago PMI. The final two slots are the only hours outside the low band: conditional Tail 21 at 14:00 UTC for Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote with the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, and 20 at 15:00 UTC for the structurally multi-stage second leg that follows. Event weight is carried mainly by Stress, which climbs from 46 to 72 across the horizon, rather than by an asserted price path: nothing about the keynote's content can be known at the assessment cutoff.
